description: Conservation and Adaptation Resources Toolbox (CART) is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USFWS, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service; U.S. Bureau of Reclamation; South Central Climate Adaptation Science Center. By connecting hundreds of individuals from dozens of organizations across North America, the Conservation and Adaptation Resources Toolbox (CART) helps bridge the gaps between work at project, landscape, and operational scales. The dashboard supports knowledge sharing, co-develops tools, and supports collaborative action to improve management outcomes for priority issues. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
